title: Fast Learning Radiance Fields · 局部放大式视觉对比

description.zh: 完整场景之外叠加两组彩色边框与对应局部放大图，让画质差异可以定位到具体纹理和几何细节。
description.en: Pairs full rendered scenes with colored detail crops so differences can be inspected at a known image location.

zh: 评价重建、NeRF、超分和图像复原结果，差异集中在小区域时。
en: Comparing reconstruction, novel-view synthesis or restoration models when differences are localized.

zh: 全局场景保留可解释上下文，局部 crop 用同色边框连接；放大窗口能突出边缘、纹理而不抛弃原视图。
en: A full-scene context pairs with matching colored zoom-insets, focusing attention on texture and edge differences.

zh: 不同输出应使用同一 crop 坐标、尺度和输入条件；不能只挑某个方法最差的位置。
en: Crops must share coordinates, scale and conditions; do not selectively magnify a baseline's weakest region.
